$description: components tokens written under :root Written on :root and on every density and interaction context, so a component token that points to a density role is computed where the region sets its density (a custom property is computed where it is declared; batch 221).

button-ghost-hover-icon.$description: Button, subtle (ghost): the icon on hover, in the action color (Fluent’s subtle buttons).

button-danger-secondary-border.$description: Danger on a surface (not on the soft fill): the danger solid, red-700 in light and red-200 in dark, at least 4.5:1 on the surfaces; feedback-danger-content is the text on the soft danger fill (2026-10-12: kept red when that role moved to red-100 in dark).

button-danger-secondary-text.$description: Danger on a surface (not on the soft fill): the danger solid, red-700 in light and red-200 in dark, at least 4.5:1 on the surfaces; feedback-danger-content is the text on the soft danger fill (2026-10-12: kept red when that role moved to red-100 in dark).

before: /* states: selected (its border and text come from the size), disabled, focus */

button-label-clip-margin.$description: Button label: how far past its trimmed box the label may draw before it is clipped, so a descender (g, y) is not cut (the label box is trimmed to the letters: text-box trim-both cap alphabetic; owner, 2026-10-29, #610).

button-target-inset-block.$description: Button: how far its hit area reaches past its top and bottom (0: the button itself; on touch, up to the target size).

button-target-inset-inline.$description: Button: how far its hit area reaches past its sides (0: the button itself; on touch, up to the target size).

before: /* the left navigation pane (NavPane): one surface and width for every page */

nav-bar-height.$description: The bottom navigation bar at Narrow (Platforms Standard 4.1, 6.4): a 44px target per destination with its label under the icon

secondary-pane-width-min.$description: The narrowest a resizable secondary pane can be dragged: 180px on every window. The small width (secondary-pane-width-sm) rises on larger windows, so it is no longer the minimum.

secondary-pane-width-sm-from-1440.$description: The secondary pane widths in a window 1440px wide up to 1919px (owner, issue 463 option C, step 2): each steps up one size; grid.css sets secondary-pane-width-sm, -md and -lg to them there.

secondary-pane-width-sm-from-1920.$description: The secondary pane widths in a window 1920px wide and wider.

side-panel-width-default-from-1440.$description: The side panel's starting width in a window 1440px wide up to 1919px (owner, issue 463 option C, step 2); grid.css sets side-panel-width-default to it there.

side-panel-width-default-from-1920.$description: The side panel's starting width in a window 1920px wide and wider.

input-invalid-border-color.$description: Danger on a surface (not on the soft fill): the danger solid, red-700 in light and red-200 in dark, at least 4.5:1 on the surfaces; feedback-danger-content is the text on the soft danger fill (2026-10-12: kept red when that role moved to red-100 in dark).

select-list-background.$description: Select: the open list, the same surface as a Menu.

select-list-border-width.$description: Select: the open list border width.

select-list-margin-block-start.$description: Select: the space between the field and its list.

select-list-max-height.$description: Select: the list scrolls past this height.

select-list-padding.$description: Select: the space inside the list around its rows.

select-option-font-size.$description: Select: a row text size, the Combobox's (the approved picture).

select-option-min-height.$description: Select: a row height, the Combobox's: 28px at the compact density (the approved picture).

select-option-padding-inline.$description: Select: the space at a row start and end.

select-option-active-background.$description: Select: the row under the pointer or the arrow keys, the same gray as a Menu row.

select-option-selected-background.$description: Select: the chosen row's light blue tint (the Combobox's active tint), also while the row is active.

select-option-selected-text.$description: Select: the chosen row text color.

select-option-disabled-text.$description: Select: a disabled row text color.

select-group-padding-block.$description: Select: a group heading vertical space.

select-group-padding-inline.$description: Select: a group heading horizontal space.

switch-target-inset.$description: The invisible target layer around a switch without a visible label: it grows the target to the minimum target (Platforms Standard 3.1) without changing the track

segmented-item-target-inset-block.$description: How far a segmented option's invisible target reaches above and below it: up to the minimum target (24px with a mouse, 44px with touch), centered (Platforms Standard 3.1)

field-required-text.$description: Danger on a surface (not on the soft fill): the danger solid, red-700 in light and red-200 in dark, at least 4.5:1 on the surfaces; feedback-danger-content is the text on the soft danger fill (2026-10-12: kept red when that role moved to red-100 in dark).

field-error-text.$description: Danger on a surface (not on the soft fill): the danger solid, red-700 in light and red-200 in dark, at least 4.5:1 on the surfaces; feedback-danger-content is the text on the soft danger fill (2026-10-12: kept red when that role moved to red-100 in dark).

data-grid-data-font-family.$description: A column of kind "data" (IDs, file names, paths, versions, dates, sizes, counts): the data font, Reddit Mono, at the table's own size and line height so it shares the row's baseline (owner, 2026-10-11)

data-grid-title-reserve.$description: DataGrid header: the room the title leaves at its end for the menu button (the button's inset and width, less the cell padding the title area already stops short by, plus a 4px gap).

action-bar-block-size.$description: The height of a one-row ActionBar (its padding, its line and a standard button): the scroll padding at the bottom of a scrolling area with a stuck bar, so a focused element is never hidden behind it (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.11; Platforms Standard 8.1)

badge-radius.$description: Badge: 4px corners, as every pill (owner, 2026-10-14, docs/pills-and-colors.md).

badge-neutral-text.$description: Badge, neutral: the text, shade 700 (800 for negative).

badge-waiting-background.$description: Badge, waiting (waiting, paused): the soft background, shade 100 (owner, 2026-10-14, docs/pills-and-colors.md).

badge-waiting-text.$description: Badge, waiting: the text, shade 700 (800 for negative).

badge-action-required-background.$description: Badge, action-required (action or correction required): the soft background, shade 100 (owner, 2026-10-14, docs/pills-and-colors.md).

badge-action-required-text.$description: Badge, action-required: the text, shade 700 (800 for negative).

badge-negative-background.$description: Badge, negative (failed, error, rejected): the soft background, shade 100 (owner, 2026-10-14, docs/pills-and-colors.md).

badge-negative-text.$description: Badge, negative: the text, shade 700 (800 for negative).

count-pill-radius.$description: Counter pill: 4px corners, as every pill (owner, 2026-10-14, docs/pills-and-colors.md).

count-pill-info-border.$description: Count pill, info: the active status pill border, shade 300.

count-pill-success-text.$description: Count pill, success: the success status pill text.

count-pill-success-border.$description: Count pill, success: the success status pill border, shade 300.

count-pill-warning-text.$description: Count pill, warning: the waiting status pill text.

count-pill-warning-border.$description: Count pill, warning: the waiting status pill border, shade 300.

count-pill-danger-text.$description: Count pill, danger: the negative status pill text.

count-pill-danger-border.$description: Count pill, danger: the negative status pill border, shade 300.

notice-info-border.$description: Two shades darker than the notice fill (owner, 2026-10-09).

notice-warning-border.$description: Two shades darker than the notice fill (owner, 2026-10-09).

notice-danger-border.$description: Two shades darker than the notice fill (owner, 2026-10-09).

tag-radius.$description: Tag and chip: 4px corners, as every pill (owner, 2026-10-14, docs/pills-and-colors.md).

tag-remove-hover-text.$description: Danger on a surface (not on the soft fill): the danger solid, red-700 in light and red-200 in dark, at least 4.5:1 on the surfaces; feedback-danger-content is the text on the soft danger fill (2026-10-12: kept red when that role moved to red-100 in dark).

chip-target-inset.$description: The invisible target layer around a chip and its toggle: it grows the target to the minimum target (Platforms Standard 3.1) without changing the 20px look; 0 where the chip already meets it

tabs-segmented-tab-border-color.$description: One line between two joined tabs; the group's outer edge.

tabs-segmented-tab-joined-radius.$description: The corners where two tabs join (square).

tabs-segmented-tab-font-weight.$description: The same weight selected or not: the tint marks the selected tab.

app-header-search-view-bar-min-height.$description: The search view's top row: the header's height

menu-item-danger-text.$description: Danger on a surface (not on the soft fill): the danger solid, red-700 in light and red-200 in dark, at least 4.5:1 on the surfaces; feedback-danger-content is the text on the soft danger fill (2026-10-12: kept red when that role moved to red-100 in dark).

app-header-accent-selected-content.$description: The accent app header's selected content

app-header-frost-brand.$description: The frost app header's brand: the brand role (brand-primary)

app-header-plain-selected-content.$description: The plain app header's selected content

card-icon-color.$description: Card: the color of the icon before the title, the title's color.

chat-time-text.$description: The time and status under a message: the secondary text color on both kinds of message (#637).

chat-status-read-icon.$description: The two checks of a read message: green (the owner, #637); sent and delivered stay in the footer's gray.

chat-group-row-gap.$description: The space between the messages of one sender's run (Chat.Group), tighter than between runs (#637).

collapsible-section-title-lines.$description: A wrapping heading (CollapsibleSection wrap, the navigation groups) shows at most this many lines; past them the last line ends in an ellipsis and the full title shows in a tooltip (owner, #502).

combobox-input-margin-block.$description: The input's block margins: none; with touch it reaches over the field's border (components.interaction-touch), so the whole 44px field is its target (Platforms Standard 3.1)

data-grid-row-selected-color.$description: A selected row's text: the text around it; HighlightText in forced colors, on the Highlight fill.

data-grid-list-intrinsic-width.$description: The width a grid that can become a Narrow list asks for where its container takes the width of its content (a size container has no content width of its own): wide enough to stay a table.

data-grid-list-padding-block.$description: A Narrow grid's list item (platforms.md 6.5): the space above and below its lines.

data-grid-list-row-gap.$description: A Narrow grid's list item: the space between its title line and the lines under it.

data-grid-list-line-height.$description: A Narrow grid's list item: the line height of each key column's line.

data-grid-list-detail-text.$description: A Narrow grid's list item: the lines under the title (the key columns after the first).

empty-state-error-icon-text.$description: The error tone (platforms.md 5.5: it names the problem, one action recovers): the icon in the danger color; the words say what failed, so color is never the only sign. Danger on a surface (not on the soft fill): the danger solid, red-700 in light and red-200 in dark, at least 4.5:1 on the surfaces; feedback-danger-content is the text on the soft danger fill (2026-10-12: kept red when that role moved to red-100 in dark).

list-item-danger-icon-text.$description: Danger on a surface (not on the soft fill): the danger solid, red-700 in light and red-200 in dark, at least 4.5:1 on the surfaces; feedback-danger-content is the text on the soft danger fill (2026-10-12: kept red when that role moved to red-100 in dark).

metric-change-danger-text.$description: Danger on a surface (not on the soft fill): the danger solid, red-700 in light and red-200 in dark, at least 4.5:1 on the surfaces; feedback-danger-content is the text on the soft danger fill (2026-10-12: kept red when that role moved to red-100 in dark).

nav-list-heading-lines.$description: A static group heading shows at most this many lines (balanced); past them the last line ends in an ellipsis and the full text shows in a tooltip (owner, issue 502).

nav-list-heading-line-height.$description: The line height of a wrapping static group heading: with the heading's padding, one line stays 32px and two lines are 40px (owner, issue 502).

nav-list-heading-min-height.$description: A static group heading's height: the collapsible group heading's (one geometry for both, #49).

nav-list-heading-margin-block-end.$description: Room under a static group heading: the collapsible group's room above its rows (#49).

nav-list-pin-pinned-background.$description: A pinned row's pin: no fill; Highlight in forced colors (a toggle that is on).

nav-list-item-muted-text.$description: Danger on a surface (not on the soft fill): the danger solid, red-700 in light and red-200 in dark, at least 4.5:1 on the surfaces; feedback-danger-content is the text on the soft danger fill (2026-10-12: kept red when that role moved to red-100 in dark).

row-button-selected-text.$description: A selected row's text: its own color (the text around it); HighlightText in forced colors.

row-button-selected-shadow.$description: RowButton: the selected row's 1px inset ring, as the navigation pane's current item (owner, 2026-10-19).

row-button-radius.$description: RowButton: its corners, as the navigation pane's items (owner, 2026-10-19).

section-heading-level-4-font-size.$description: Section heading: the size of a level 4 heading (h4: a part inside a section): 10px from the type scale, smaller than level 3 (owner, 2026-10-12).

segmented-joined-radius.$description: SegmentedControl: the corners where two segments join (square).

segmented-border-color.$description: SegmentedControl: the edge of the group and the line between segments (a secondary button's edge).

segmented-border-width.$description: SegmentedControl: the width of the edge and of the lines between segments.

segmented-item-text.$description: SegmentedControl: an unchosen segment's text and icon.

segmented-item-min-height.$description: SegmentedControl: the segment height, the button control height (a medium button).

segmented-sm-item-min-height.$description: SegmentedControl size sm: the segment height of a small button.

segmented-item-hover-background.$description: SegmentedControl: an unchosen segment under the pointer.

segmented-item-selected-background.$description: SegmentedControl: the chosen segment, the selected-state blue tint (owner, 2026-10-14: look A).

segmented-item-selected-text.$description: SegmentedControl: the chosen segment's text and icon, the selected blue.

segmented-item-focus-layer.$description: SegmentedControl: a focused segment sits above its neighbors so its ring is not covered.

bulk-actions-divider-border-inline-start.$description: The divider before Select all and Clear.

secondary-pane-back-padding-inline.$description: Space before and after the Back control.

settings-section-title-text.$description: Settings: a section title, the h2 heading of its card (owner, 2026-10-13: no eyebrow style).

settings-section-title-font-size.$description: Settings: the size of a section title at level 2 (the default): the level 2 section heading size, 13px (owner, 2026-10-12: the titles grow with the heading levels).

settings-section-title-font-family.$description: Settings: the family of a section title, as a panel title.

settings-section-title-level-3-font-size.$description: Settings: the size of a section title at level 3 (headingLevel 3): the level 3 section heading size, 11px.

settings-section-title-level-4-font-size.$description: Settings: the size of a section title at level 4 (headingLevel 4): the level 4 section heading size, 10px.

settings-section-title-font-weight.$description: Settings: the weight of a section title, as a panel title.

settings-section-header-padding-block.$description: Settings: the space above and below a section card's header (title and description).

settings-section-header-border-bottom-co.$description: Settings: the line between a section card's header and its rows.

settings-section-header-border-bottom-wi.$description: Settings: the width of the line between a section card's header and its rows.

settings-section-description-margin-bloc.$description: Settings: the space between a section title and its description.

settings-section-toggle-min-height.$description: Settings: the least height of a collapsible section's header button (its target).

settings-section-toggle-gap.$description: Settings: the space between a collapsible section's title and its chevron.

settings-section-toggle-hover-text.$description: Settings: the chevron of a collapsible section's header under the pointer.

settings-section-toggle-focus-outline-co.$description: Settings: the focus ring of a collapsible section's header button.

settings-section-toggle-focus-outline-of.$description: Settings: the space between the header button and its focus ring.

settings-section-toggle-focus-outline-wi.$description: Settings: the width of the header button's focus ring.

settings-section-chevron-text.$description: Settings: the chevron at the end of a collapsible section's header (down when open).

settings-section-chevron-duration.$description: Settings: how long the chevron takes to turn.

settings-row-narrow-row-gap.$description: Settings: in a narrow section the control moves under its label; the space between them.

settings-section-block-gap.$description: Settings: the space above and below a block in a card that is not a row (a table, a toolbar, a list).

settings-section-chevron-easing.$description: Settings: the easing of the chevron's turn.

list-icon-size.$description: The icon beside a list item

avatar-background.$description: An avatar in the theme colors: its fill

avatar-content.$description: An avatar in the theme colors: its initials

toolbar-bar-group-gap.$description: Toolbar, bar variant (CommandBar): the space between its groups; density does not change it

toolbar-bar-control-gap.$description: Toolbar, bar variant (CommandBar): the space between the controls of a group; density does not change it

button-joined-radius.$description: Button joined: the corners where it meets a neighbor (a ButtonGroup, an InputGroup, a CopyButton field).

button-joined-focus-layer.$description: Button joined: the layer it rises to while focused, so its focus ring shows whole.

select-joined-radius.$description: Select joined: the corners where its control meets the field (an InputGroup).

select-joined-focus-layer.$description: Select joined: the layer it rises to while focused.

input-group-compact-box-width.$description: InputGroup compact: the short box (NumberInput quantity).

input-group-compact-padding-inline.$description: InputGroup compact: the room at the ends of the centered value.

input-group-joined-radius.$description: InputGroup: the box's corners where an attached button or select meets it.

copy-button-field-joined-radius.$description: CopyButton field: the value's end corners where the button meets it.
